old-permit-form.title: 2013 Neighborhood Permit
old-permit-form.content: A permit form bearing an old neighborhood signature and a narrow flood-route annotation.

storm-ledger.title: 2013 Storm Ledger
storm-ledger.content: A dated ledger of storm calls, equipment checkout, and one incomplete witness line.

original-export.title: Original Export
original-export.content: A machine export whose timestamps disagree with the summary sheet.

union-audit.title: Union Audit Packet
union-audit.content: Rows of reimbursements with two unlabeled totals and a handwritten correction.

access-plan.title: Access Route Plan
access-plan.content: A draft route plan with a missing curb measurement near the north gate.

bank-timeline.title: Cooperative Payment Timeline
bank-timeline.content: A payment timeline prepared for a bank review, with one invoice still disputed.

editor-draft.title: Campus Paper Draft
editor-draft.content: A draft article with a protected source and several claims marked for verification.

blue-rabbit-register.title: Blue Rabbit Sticker Register
blue-rabbit-register.content: A water-damaged register containing a child-sized sticker inventory.

permit-review-outcome.title: Permit Review Outcome
permit-review-outcome.content: A short review record concluding the 2013 permit flood-route annotation is not current guidance; the original stays with its holder.

storm-records.title: Recovered Harbor Storm Records
storm-records.content: Recovered harbor logs confirming which storm calls were logged and who checked out equipment on the night of the storm.

bank-resolution.title: Bank Resolution Note
bank-resolution.content: A bank note confirming the disputed invoice was resolved and the cooperative payment timeline reconciled.

holds historical material and its staff control access to fragile originals.

# 2013 Storm Ledger

the manifest. This description is world data, not an automatic grant of
knowledge: an actor must physically reach the document and spend time reading
it, or receive a concrete copy or message.

The archive's machine-generated export. Its timestamps can be compared with
the audit packet, but comparison is an actor action and not a plot flag.
